$comment: Asks for tools/web-eval/model-check.mjs. A fresh Claude session answers each with only WebFetch on svgrid.com. need = regular expressions the component must match (the API the ask cannot be done without); forbid = ones it must not (a write that skips the feature).

tasks.ask: Add change review to a customer grid (id, company, region): edits from an AI agent must be held as proposals, shown in a review panel next to the grid, and written to the rows only when a person accepts them.
A product grid with name, price, stock and ten more columns, where the name column stays pinned to the left while the rest scrolls horizontally.
A grid of orders with a button that downloads the current rows as an Excel .xlsx file.
In a paginated grid, given a row id, find which page the row is on and go to that page.
Use the AI helpers to fill the empty Region cells from the Country column, but let a person review the guesses before they are written.
